job.style: a short story with Indian characters in everyday life

passage: In a bustling classroom in Delhi, Rohan and Meera were discussing their weekend plans. Rohan, who speaks Hindi at home, noticed a new student, Zoya, who spoke a different regional language and wore a traditional headscarf. Rohan whispered to Meera, 'She probably won't be good at sports because people from her region are always very quiet and shy.' Meera shook her head and replied, 'That is not true, Rohan. Just because she looks or speaks differently does not mean she is less capable or unequal to us. Everyone has their own unique personality, and we cannot judge her based on a group she belongs to.' Later, their teacher explained that prejudice means judging others negatively before knowing them, rather than just having a strong opinion. She emphasized that our Constitution guarantees equality for all, regardless of their background, language, or caste. The teacher reminded them that diversity is our strength, and treating someone unfairly because of their identity is discrimination. Rohan realized that his assumption was a stereotype, a fixed image he had created in his mind. He walked over to Zoya and invited her to play, understanding that being different is a natural part of our society and does not make anyone inferior.

items.evidence: Later, their teacher explained that prejudice means judging others negatively before knowing them, rather than just having a strong opinion.
items.q: How is prejudice different from simply holding a strong opinion?
options: It judges people before knowing them
It is a feeling shared by a whole class
It means disliking people after meeting them
It is a belief that comes from facts
items.explain: Prejudice is judging others negatively before knowing them, not just having a strong opinion.

wrong.why: thinks prejudice is a group feeling
thinks meeting a person changes how prejudice works
thinks stereotypes and prejudice rest on facts

items.evidence: Just because she looks or speaks differently does not mean she is less capable or unequal to us.
items.q: Zoya speaks another language and dresses differently. What does this tell us about her?
options: She is equal to every other student
She is less equal but just as capable
She belongs in a separate group
She is quieter than most students
items.explain: Differences in language or clothes do not make anyone less capable or unequal.

wrong.why: thinks different language or clothes means unequal
thinks diversity means groups stay apart
thinks a group shares one personality

items.evidence: Rohan whispered to Meera, 'She probably won't be good at sports because people from her region are always very quiet and shy.'
items.q: Which shows Rohan using a stereotype about Zoya?
options: Guessing her sports skill from her region
Whispering to Meera during the class
Inviting her to play after the lesson
Speaking Hindi while she spoke another language
items.explain: Rohan assumed Zoya would be weak at sports only because of her region, which is a stereotype.

wrong.why: picks a true detail that is not the stereotype
thinks different languages themselves show inequality

items.evidence: Everyone has their own unique personality, and we cannot judge her based on a group she belongs to.
items.q: Why was Rohan wrong to judge Zoya by her region?
options: Each person has a personality of their own
Her region has no quiet or shy people
Everyone in a region is exactly alike
Judging is fine if the opinion is kind
items.explain: Everyone has a unique personality, so one cannot judge a person by the group she belongs to.

wrong.why: thinks all group members share traits
thinks only unkind judging counts as prejudice

items.evidence: He walked over to Zoya and invited her to play, understanding that being different is a natural part of our society and does not make anyone inferior.
items.q: Rohan now accepts that differences are natural. How will he most likely treat Zoya?
options: As an equal who can join the game
As a guest who should stay apart
As a student who must change her dress
As a friend only after a long wait
items.explain: Rohan saw that being different does not make anyone inferior, so he invited Zoya to play.

wrong.why: thinks different groups should not mix
thinks different clothes need fixing to be equal
thinks prejudice fades only after a long time
